name: Lewatit VP OC 1065, Young 2021 coupled water-CO2 conditional

evidence.basis: Published Young 2021 dry/wet Toth and GAB fits are evaluated with local bed temperature and water activity. The native cycle transfer and caloric constants are explicit process-model assumptions.
evidence.not_for: measured humid-cycle validation, independent coadsorption validation, hot-vacuum kinetic validation, hardware qualification, cyclic steady state, lifetime, or annual production.

shaped_material.basis: The app case supplies a dry shaped resin mass; the source measured resin sample is not a shaped device.
shaped_material.binder_support: Commercial resin beads are represented as the dry resin solid; no binder or support is added.
shaped_material.particle_geometry: The case particle diameter is a transfer assumption and is not fitted to this source.

co2.source_locator: Young et al. 2021 DOI 10.1039/D1EE01272J Tables 2 and 4; process heat from SI Table S9

water.source_locator: Young et al. 2021 DOI 10.1039/D1EE01272J equations 5-8 and 25-26; process heat from SI Table S9
water.basis: GAB is fitted to unary water data. CO2 is assumed not to modify the water equilibrium.

kinetics.evidence_status: Process-model constants from Young 2021 SI Table S9. Equal adsorption/desorption, humid-CO2 transfer and hot-vacuum transfer are assumptions, not measured validation.

adsorbed_energy.basis: Constant CP_GAS and process heats 70/46 kJ/mol preserve the existing reference convention.

assumptions: Local relative humidity is p_H2O / p_sat(T_bed) from the evolving bed gas inventory, including evacuation and regeneration.
Relative-humidity values between the source dry, 30% and 55% evidence conditions are a continuous conditional interpolation, not independently sampled or validated states.
Water loading is the GAB target from local gas conditions and, through LDF, affects the WADST CO2 target.
CO2 does not modify the unary water equilibrium; this reverse coupling is unavailable in the source fit.
Adsorption and desorption LDF constants are equal and applied to a humid mixed feed and hot vacuum without kinetic validation.
The 70 and 46 kJ/mol process heats and native constant gas Cp are a conditional energy closure, not a complete reciprocal WADST thermodynamic model.
No water-dependent kinetic multiplier is introduced because supporting data are unavailable.

validity.equilibrium: Reproduced bounded Young 2021 fit; graphical coadsorption evidence is not an independent validation data set.
validity.water: Conditional local-activity behavior inside RH 0-0.55; the unresolved 80% RH extension is rejected.
validity.cycle: No measured humid adsorption or hot-vacuum trajectory establishes native kinetic or caloric predictive validity.
validity.initial_state_interpretation: Equilibrated initialization is a numerical scenario state, not cyclic steady state.

uncertainty.statement: Equilibrium is source reproduced within the declared domain; native humid-cycle kinetics and energy closure remain conditional and are not experimentally validated.
